title: In Splunk SOAR versions below 8.8.0, an authenticated user could cause Splunk SOAR to store excessive data in the…
description: In Splunk SOAR versions below 8.8.0, an authenticated user can cause the system to store excessive data in the Ingestion Status history via the REST API. This occurs because there is no limit on the amount of request data recorded for failed container creation attempts. When another user with permission to view system settings accesses this history, the large stored data can cause increased resource usage and degrade the availability of administrative monitoring.
